_comment: [SONNET-4.6] sq-gg0qq.6 — the honest coverage ledger for the vendored jeswr/lws-spec
conformance corpus, asserted EXACTLY by tests/lws_spec_vectors.rs. Every one of the 157
vendored cases appears in exactly one bucket: `evaluated` operations are reproduced in Rust
and their verdicts are diffed against the vectors; `pending` operations are not implemented
yet and are counted, never silently skipped.
The assertion is equality in BOTH directions, so this file must be edited deliberately when
coverage grows (move an operation from `pending` to `evaluated`) or when the vendored pin is
refreshed (a corpus that gained, lost, or re-classified a vector). A green suite therefore
means 'exactly this much is covered', not 'nothing failed'.
Next slice: `http-exchange` is the largest pending bucket and needs a live-server harness
over the assembled LDP router; the remaining pure-function operations (validate-*, verify-*,
evaluate-*) need no server and are cheaper.
